# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝ ☝ ✌ ✌ 🤟 🖐]

I can see the bomb’s complete visible state: display `0`, red light, and three wires in order blue, green, red. I will send these facts by speech to the Blind, who can act, and also to the Mute, who can use the manual. The Mute’s six gestures do not have an established meaning for me yet, so I will report their sequence to the Blind descriptively.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Visible state: display is 0. Indicator light is red. Wires from 1 to 3 are blue, green, red. Mute signalled six gestures in this order: first repeated twice, second repeated twice, third, fourth.")
speak(to="mute", text="I see display 0, red light, and wires 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red. Please use the manual to determine the required action and tell Blind.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [white]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝ ☝ ☝]

The display and wire colours are unchanged, but the indicator light is now white. The Mute has made three identical gestures; I cannot infer their meaning without the manual, so I will report the observation. Blind needs the current visual state, while Mute should interpret the gesture sequence and manual together.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Update: display remains 0; wires remain 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red; indicator light is now white. Mute signalled three repetitions of the first gesture.")
speak(to="mute", text="Update: display 0; light changed to white; wires remain 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red. I observed your three identical gestures. Please interpret the current state from the manual and instruct Blind.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝ ☝ ☝ ✌ ✌ 🤟 🖐]

The visible state has changed again: the display remains `0`, the wires remain blue, green, red, and the light is now green. The Mute’s gesture sequence is the same opening three upward-pointing gestures as last turn, followed by two victory signs, then a crossed-fingers sign and a raised-palm sign. I will relay the exact observed sequence descriptively to Blind and the current state to both teammates.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Current state: display 0; light is green; wires 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red. Mute gestures were: ☝ ☝ ☝ ✌ ✌ 🤟 🖐 — three upward index signs, two V signs, crossed fingers, then raised palm.")
speak(to="mute", text="Current visual state: display 0, light green, wires 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red. I observed your sequence ☝ ☝ ☝ ✌ ✌ 🤟 🖐. Please continue relaying the manual's required action to Blind.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝ ☝]

The display remains `0` and the wire colours remain blue, green, red, while the light has changed back to red. The Mute has now signalled two upward-pointing gestures. I will send the exact visual state and gesture observation to Blind; the Mute can continue interpreting the manual and communicating its instructions.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Current state: display 0; light is red; wires 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red. Mute signalled exactly: ☝ ☝.")
speak(to="mute", text="Current state remains display 0 with wires 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red; light is red. I observed your two gestures: ☝ ☝. Please relay the manual instruction to Blind.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [white]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝ ☝ ☝]

The display and wire order remain unchanged. The light has changed from red to white. The Mute again signalled three upward-pointing gestures, matching the sequence seen in turn 2. I cannot determine the manual’s required action from these observations, so I will relay the current bomb state and exact gesture sequence to Blind.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Turn 5 state: display 0; light is white; wires 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red. Mute signalled exactly three upward-pointing gestures: ☝ ☝ ☝.")
speak(to="mute", text="Turn 5: display 0, white light, wires 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red. I observed ☝ ☝ ☝. Please convey the manual's instruction to Blind through the established signalling.")
```
